newsitem.title: USA: GTE says to buy up additional 20 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: GTE says to buy up additional 20 mln shares.

text.p: GTE Corp said Thursday that its board of directors authorized the company to repurchase an additional 20 million shares of its common stock. That is in addition to the six million shares left unpurchased from a 25 million share buy-back plan that began one year ago, the company said in a statement.

GTE said the repurchases would be made in both the open market and through private transactions and will occur from time to time in the future depending upon market conditions and the company's need to finance new or expanded business opportunities.
The announcement was made in conjuction with GTE declaring its 245 consecutive dividend. The company declared a regular quarterly stock dividend of 47 cents a share.
The company says it has roughly 955 million shares outsanding.
